messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: high error rate and metering anomaly detected for dedicated pool grayridge-vpc-1 (tenant: grayridge-enterprises). Severity: P2. Investigate. Runbook: /runbooks/dedicated-pool-degradation

jordan.smith: On it. Picking this up — I'm the current on-call. Assign to SRE lead and billing.

mira.chen: @jordan.smith seeing increased 500s from infer runtime on nodes in grayridge-vpc-1. Also note metering pipeline shows duplicated ingest events for tenant grayridge-enterprises starting ~1813456500.

samir.kapoor: FYI billing noticed an unexpected token spike for GrayRidge yesterday evening, opened a ticket but thought it was a client load surge. Can share ledger vs live-meter diffs.

jordan.smith: Can you paste the quick reconciliation? need to know if this is overcount (meter double-emitting) or undercount (ledger missing events).

samir.kapoor: quick snapshot:``` 
SELECT count(*) FROM live_meter_events
WHERE tenant_id='grayridge-enterprises' AND ts BETWEEN 1813456400 AND 1813457000;
-- result: 1,208,412

SELECT count(*) FROM billing_ledger
WHERE tenant='grayridge-enterprises' AND ts BETWEEN 1813456400 AND 1813457000;
-- result: 604,206
```

samir.kapoor: looks exactly 2x; suspect duplicate event ingestion.

mira.chen: That's consistent with what I see in the kafka topic + consumer offsets — the metering consumer group processed the same partition twice due to a rebalance + duplicate commit bug after a node restart.

leila_hart: Heads up — GrayRidge account manager here. Customer is on a reserved/dedicated plan and flagged billing suddenly jumping this morning. They might escalate if invoices go wrong. What's mitigation?

jordan.smith: Immediate steps: 1) isolate tenant traffic from grayridge-vpc-1 to stop further duplicate events into billing pipeline, 2) enable temporary dedupe in the meter-processor (fast toggle), 3) open billing reconciliation action and stop auto-invoice for GrayRidge until fixed.

devon.ops: I can push a traffic rule to route new requests for tenant grayridge-enterprises to shared-pool-2 (read-only for now) — that'll stop generating new billing events from the dedicated pool. Need :thumbsup: from SRE to proceed.

oncall-sre: +1 proceed with reroute. Add rate-limit 10 req/s per API key for the tenant while we finish triage.

mira.chen: Executing steps: 1) applied iptables rule to blackhole meter-proxy for tenant on grayridge-vpc-1 (will prevent new events); 2) toggled dedupe flag on meter-processor (feature flag: meter.dedupe.enforce = true).

incident-bot: ACTION: meter.dedupe.enforce=true applied by mira.chen at 1813456872.

samir.kapoor: Confirming dedupe toggle suppressed duplicate ingestion downstream. Running backfill/reconciliation now to compute correct counts. Long job, will update ETA ~20-30m.

jordan.smith: Good. Devon, proceed with reroute when ready. Also create a copy of the raw kafka partition for forensic analysis (we will need to verify unique event ids).

devon.ops: Reroute in progress: redirecting tenant namespace grayridge-enterprises -> shared-pool-2, throttling applied. Command: `rdctl routes set grayridge-enterprises --dest shared-pool-2 --rate 10/s`

mira.chen: Pulled a sample from the meter topic. Found events with identical `event_id` values but different offsets (duplicate emission). Example log:```
{"event_id":"evt_9a7f3","tenant":"grayridge-enterprises","tokens":1024,"ts":1813456554}
{"event_id":"evt_9a7f3","tenant":"grayridge-enterprises","tokens":1024,"ts":1813456554}
```

samir.kapoor: After dedupe/backfill: live unique events => 604,208 (matches ledger +- small drift). Looks like dedupe recovered ~604k duplicates.

leila_hart: Thanks all. I'll message the GrayRidge contact: "we've detected duplicate billing events originating from our dedicated pool due to a processing bug; we've isolated the issue, throttled traffic, and are reconciling your usage. No actionable invoice will be generated until we've reconciled. Will follow up with timeline."

jordan.smith: Next: root cause RCA — meter consumer rebalance bug after node restart. Owner: eng-infra. Proposed immediate permanent fix: add idempotency checks to consumer commit path + stronger consumer group monitoring.

mira.chen: Filing infra PR to prevent double-commit and adding metrics alert `meter_consumer_duplicate_emits > 0`. Also will add an automated reconciliation job every 6 hours for dedicated-pool tenants.

samir.kapoor: Billing action: created internal ticket BL-4278 to apply a credit if needed and hold invoice generation for GrayRidge until reconciliation is complete.

oncall-sre: Handoff: @jordan.smith monitoring for next 2 hours, @mira.chen to validate backfill completion. If duplication reappears escalate to infra oncall.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity downgraded to P3. New status: mitigated (duplication suppressed, reroute applied, reconciliation running). Next update in 30m or on completion.

jordan.smith: closing loop: no customer traffic errors reported after reroute. Billing variance resolved in backfill. Action items tracked in incident board: https://redwood.atlassian.net/board/INC-1823

leila_hart: I'll coordinate postmortem comms and draft a note for the account with the reconciliation numbers and any invoice adjustments.

samir.kapoor: ETA on full backfill verification ~25m, will post final numbers once done.

mira.chen: final note: the duplicated events were limited to grayridge-vpc-1 and only affected meter-ingest path; inference outputs were unaffected.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: all mitigations complete, billing reconciliation finished, P3 -> resolved at 1813457190. Postmortem required."
